The '''Rare Disc''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be obtained from:
* Dropped by a [[Bats|Bat]] (regular, frost, or lava).
* Dropped by a [[Shadow Brute]].
* Dropped by a [[Shadow Shaman]].
* Dropped by a [[Shadow Sniper]].
* Dropped by a [[Spider]].
* Gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].
* Inside a [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chest]].
* Inside an [[Artifact Trove]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].  To earn the [['Burnt Offering']] reward, you must donate a Rare Disc, a [[Dwarf Gadget]], and 11+ artifacts.

The Rare Disc is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Navy Tuxedo]].  [[File:Shirt185.png|24px]]
